relationships.evidence_quote: These findings validated that TLR4, MyD88 and TRPV1 were all up-regulated in L4-6 DRGs following intraperitoneal paclitaxel administration in rats model.

relationships.subject: TLR4

relationships.evidence_quote: SGD elicited significant and persistent relief from thermal hyperalgesia from day 8 compared to that produced by single paclitaxel treatment.

key_findings: SGD relieved paclitaxel-induced thermal hyperalgesia (not mechanical allodynia) in rats.
